create_stretch2d: create a Stretch2d module to upsample a 2D tensor by specified x and y scale factors
build_upsample_network: build an UpsampleNetwork that upsamples conditional features for a wavenet vocoder
build_conv_in_upsample_network: build a ConvInUpsampleNetwork that applies a 1D convolution before upsampling conditional features
test_upsample_network: test the UpsampleNetwork forward pass with B x C x T input tensor
review_stretch2d_forward: review the Stretch2d forward method that uses F.interpolate for nearest or bilinear upsampling
